principle_violations.reason: Both AreaCalculator and VolumeCalculator classes have overlapping responsibilities related to calculation, which violates the Single Responsibility Principle. The VolumeCalculator should ideally handle volume calculations instead of reusing area calculation logic.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create distinct methods for calculating area and volume and separate the logic for different shape types, ensuring AreaCalculator focuses on area calculations and VolumeCalculator on volume calculations.

principle_violations.reason: VolumeCalculator incorrectly assumes that all shapes can be used to calculate volume as it calls the area() method which may not be appropriate for shapes that do not have a defined volume.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define a Volume interface and ensure that only shapes implementing it are processed by VolumeCalculator. This will make sure that the volume calculations are valid and align with the Liskov Substitution Principle.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
